scope_statement: Single-strain DH5α official-input run verifying deployment and official evaluation code; not evidence of multi-strain representation quality.

esmplusplus_small.note: BacBench ESMPlusPlusEmbedder._load pins this revision (Bacformer-L training-time ESM++); supersedes the earlier main snapshot 37b1a0f

environment.offline_evidence: HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 with HF_HUB_CACHE=/mnt/e/StrainFM/models/hf; models loaded from pinned local snapshots
environment.gpu_status_at_run: RTX 5090 D 1.6GB free, 97% util -> CPU per deployment policy

determinism.note: CPU reruns bitwise identical; CPU vs GPU not compared bitwise

bacformer_run.note: determinism rerun with /usr/bin/time -v; first run not instrumented

metrics.protocol: BacBench 64b7d45 official operon benchmark ((cos+1)/2, strand veto)
BacBench 64b7d45 official operon benchmark ((cos+1)/2, strand veto)

commands.embed_bacformer: PYTHONPATH=<bacbench_pinned> HF_HOME=HF_HUB_CACHE=/mnt/e/StrainFM/models/hf HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1 python bacbench/modeling/run_embed_prot_seqs.py --input-parquet-path data/processed/escherichia_coli_operon_reference_20261106/ecoli_operon_reference.parquet --model-path <bacformer-large snapshot> --batch-size 8 --max-prot-seq-len 1024 --max-n-proteins 6000 --device cpu --output-filepath <operon/official_input/bacformer/ecoli_operon_bacformer.parquet>
commands.embed_esm: same with --model-path <esmplusplus_small snapshot 1e40c1b8> and esm output path

metric_recompute_note: Compact metrics recomputed from embeddings parquet with the official BacBench 64b7d45 pair-label and pair-score functions; matches official CSV AUROC/AP to 1e-5
artifact_note: Bacformer embeddings artifact recorded in commands is ecoli_operon_bacformer.parquet; the runtime-instrumented rerun is ecoli_operon_bacformer_rerun.parquet, bitwise identical (max abs diff 0.0). embeddings column is the official flat single-row nested list (4440x960); downstream consumers must reshape(4440, 960).
